Definition: properly, nearness (used only as a preposition or an adverb), near; hence, generally, with, by, at, among, etc.
BiblicalUsage: 1) with, near, together with; 1a) with, together with; 1b) with (of relationship); 1c) near (of place); 1d) with (poss.); 1e) from...with, from (with other prep)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
